no_cpa.transform: row L2 normalization only, eps=1e-12; zero rows retained

prior_only.distribution: iid Uniform[0,1), CPU torch.rand(40,25088) then row L2 normalization eps=1e-12

evaluation.metric: torchmetrics LPIPS VGG, RGB [0,1] transformed to [-1,1]
evaluation.pairing: within each B=8 victim batch, permutation-only Hungarian on absolute target embedding cosine with S_true; evaluation only, after FIA; no target sign/scale changes

constants.dataset_mean: pixelwise RGB mean of all transformed ImageNet val images, full split count logged; never substitute evaluation-40 mean

success.image_count: control-calibrated lower-tail count, not per-image significance
success.calibration: leave entire candidate victim batch out; use 32 precision-matched no-CPA LPIPS and 32 prior-only LPIPS
success.image_success: max(rank_p_no_cpa, rank_p_prior_only) <= 0.05; with 32 references this requires strict LPIPS below both control minima
success.thresholds: derive only from held-out controls, serialize thresholds.json before applying to candidate images
success.primary_group_claim: 4bit CPA improves over BOTH precision-matched no-CPA and prior-only
success.group_test: exact one-sided paired sign-flip of mean(control-CPA) across 5 victim-batch means, enumerate all 32 signs including observed; p includes ties
success.group_success: both mean effects positive and group_iut_p <= 0.05
success.secondary: fp32 hybrid row and same-36-images sensitivity; no confirmatory fp32 claim
success.assumptions: batch sign-flip symmetry; lower-tail calibration assumes cross-image comparability and is descriptive without individual FWER control

figures.histogram: one common LPIPS axis, common bins, per-condition density, all requested conditions separately labelled
figures.grid_sampling: numpy.default_rng(42).choice(40,12,replace=False), same indices both precisions, independent of losses
